newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-MAZINHO'S HAT TRICK CRUSH NEWCOMER IN J.LEAGUE OPENER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAZINHO'S HAT TRICK CRUSH NEWCOMER IN J.LEAGUE OPENER.

text.p: Brazilian striker Mazinho scored a hat trick to help titleholder Kashima Antlers down newcomer Vissel Kobe 5-2 as the J.League season opened in Japan on Saturday.
The 31-year-old midfielder scored once in the first half and twice in the second to lead the Antlers to their 100th victory in the league.

But the Antlers did not have an easy game. Vissel, promoted from second-tier Japan Football League status after last season, took the lead twice in the first half with goals by Swiss midfielder Thomas Bickel and veteran forward Akihiro Nagashima.

In other J.League action, South Korean striker Ko Jeong Woon of Cerezo Osaka made a successful regular-season debut in Japan with a 68th minute equalizer before Hiroaki Morishima's winning goal earned Cerezo a 3-2 away victory over Nagoya Grampus Eight.
Jubilo Iwata, under new Brazilian manager Luiz Felipe, beat Sanfrecce Hiroshima 2-1 at home on second half goals by Masashi Nakayama and newly acquired Brazilian defender Adilson.
Gamba Osaka marked a 4-1 home victory over Bellmare Hiratsuka, while Shimizu S-Pulse edged Kashiwa Reysol 1-0 and Flugels downed visiting Avispa Fukuoka 3-1.
First-stage action in the 17-team league continues through July 19, with each team playing 16 matches.
